notes.title: 📸 Join the Virtual Photography Gaming Event - Aim & Snap! HUGE GIVEAWAY 📸
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/249c8f11f51da3346fed5ec86a038edd3d4c67fd.png

Happy World Photography Week!

To celebrate, we’ve teamed up with the developers of TOEM, Wylde Flowers, NUTS, Alba: A Wildlife Adventure, Pupperazzi, Beasts of Maravilla Island, SEASON: A letter to the future, Umurangi Generation and Holovista  for a special 7-day event called “Aim & Snap"! The event aims to highlight the popularity of photography games as a rising sub-genre and connect fans with games they love. Virtual photography offers a non-violent alternative way to explore, create, and capture moments within gaming worlds with artful and playful challenges like these games!

All of the participating games feature a camera mechanic as a part of the core gameplay or a newly added camera mode! 

GIVEAWAY 
The event starts TODAY 19th August 0:00AM PST and runs until 26th August 23:59 PM PST. As a part of the event, we are running a HUGE giveaway competition. 3 lucky winners will get 8 games Steam keys for from participating games. 

To enter, visit aimandsnap.com! 

But wait, there’s more! All games are currently available and you can play all of them now. Even better, some of them have a free demo exclusively during this event! 

Check out the “Aim & Snap” Official Website for more information! aimandsnap.com 

🦋 The Flutter Away Team

notes.title: We've released a short demo!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 💖
We’re so excited to release a short demo of Flutter Away as a part of the Women-led Games event! 

Grab yourself a warm drink, sit down, get comfortable and delve into a cozy nook of the Amazon rainforest in a short snippet of our game.

Here are some tips for getting more out of the demo, and some things to look out for! 

Tips for enjoying our short demo 🏕
Flutter Away is a game about exploration. There is no combat, no enemies, just you and a forest full of wonders to discover. The game is designed intentionally to encourage you to slow down, take a step back and observe the world around you. This means if you rush through the gameplay, you run the risk of missing things.

We encourage you to take your time to explore the environment, look through nooks and crannies and see what you can spot! The more care you take while looking around, the more the game will reward you. 

Don’t forget to snap a picture of what you find! 📸

Things to look out for 🔎
We wanted the nature in the game to closely reflect species you can find in the real world. Our Nature Researcher Jonas highlighted a few real life species you may spot while playing the demo! 


~ WARNING SPOILERS AHEAD~ 


[spoiler]Blue Morpho (Morpho peleides)  [/spoiler]
[spoiler]Blue Morphos are kept in butterfly gardens around the world. Despite their fame, they’re often misinterpreted online with the blue appearing on both sides of their wings. Their true colors are far more intricate. [/spoiler]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/b6ae6ad6f026ae6469cdb85a7e5262df711d6310.gif

[spoiler]Dido Longwing (Philaethria dido) [/spoiler]
[spoiler]The Dido Longwing is one of the more energetic butterflies to exist! Take time to compare Dido’s fluttery exuberance to mellower Blue Morphos. [/spoiler]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/81cc5d63d8003671e90f345eaa2669b8137861bd.gif

[spoiler]Red Passion Flower (Passiflora racemosa)  [/spoiler]
[spoiler]Passion Flowers are a vine that grows through the branches of the Amazon rainforest. They are also food for many butterflies, caterpillars, and other Amazonian animals. [/spoiler]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/acd0754ff1d32018065b7d6c18ae46d13caa2d31.gif

[spoiler]Capybara (Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris) [/spoiler]
[spoiler]Capybaras are one of the chillest animals in the Amazon, but like all wildlife, they should be treated with care. Trust takes time, don’t worry if the Capybara runs away from you on Day 1! <3  [/spoiler]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/8be6ded38c90746ae92d6a60b05c160be6514ceb.gif

[spoiler]Kapok Tree (Ceiba pentandra)  [/spoiler]
[spoiler] Every individual adds to the forest - a fact best embodied by the mighty Kapok Trees that fill the Amazon forest. Kapok trees are recognisable by their broad root base and towering branches. They stand tall above the canopy and offer homes to countless creatures large and small. [/spoiler]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/f8ab2d61a365ab3e2805279a398a8245c3810fd9.gif

We hope you enjoy this short snippet of Flutter Away! Please leave us a review with your thoughts and don’t forget to wishlist the game! 💖 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2224030/Flutter_Away/

🦋 Aditia and the Flutter Away Team
